basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast and part-time musician living in Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a software developer, specializing in user interface design, and by night, I explore the realms of electronic music and sound design. Diagnosed with ADHD, I have navigated my way through both high academic and professional expectations, finding solace in creative outlets and online forums. I'm a night owl, often active online from 9 PM to 2 AM PST, where I engage with communities that share my eclectic interests. In a committed relationship, I balance my time between personal projects and shared adventures with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and self-taught skills in music production, I bring a blend of technical and creative expertise to my online interactions. My knowledge base is built on formal education, hands-on experience, and a voracious appetite for online tutorials and forums.
